**StarLine package format**

[27.03.201127.03.2011](https://web.archive.org/web/20230319212709/https:/phreakerclub.com/date/2011/03/27) | [DiezDiez](https://web.archive.org/web/20230319212709/https:/phreakerclub.com/author/diez) | 20:57

**Categories:** 

* [**AVR**](https://web.archive.org/web/20230319212709/https:/phreakerclub.com/category/avr)  
     
* [**StarLine**](https://web.archive.org/web/20230319212709/https:/phreakerclub.com/category/kodgrabber/starline-kodgrabber)

* [**Package formats**](https://web.archive.org/web/20230319212709/https:/phreakerclub.com/category/format)

The packet consists of 64 bits: 32 encrypted part, 32 open.  
The encrypted part contains: 2 bytes of a counter, 1 byte of a discriminator, 1 byte of buttons.  
The open part contains: 3 bytes of a counter, 1 byte of buttons.

*Discriminator* is a packet identification criterion, similar to a checksum.

![A graph with numbers and linesDescription automatically generated][image1]

Preamble — 1000us \\ 1000us  
Unit — 500us \\ 500us  
Zero — 250us \\ 250us

Example of a decrypted StarLine B6 package (additional key fob):

Close:

\>C480495A 56920A46  
\#EE8C5646 56920A46  
\>526F9C3A 56D20A46  
\#EF8C5646 56D20A46

Open:

\>7FC95B1C 56920A22  
\#F08C5622 56920A22  
\>A1D23D66 56920A22  
\#F18C5622 56920A22

Ch./Prog:

\>D8B39377 56920A13  
\#F28C5613 56920A13  
\>4BF2784C 56920A13  
\#F38C5613 56920A13
